command:
cd /Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c/evidence/m5/r2; E=b-panel
cat > $E/compare.py <<'EOF'
import json, csv
base='/Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c/evidence/m5/r2/'
cli=json.load(open(base+'cli-m0.json'))
ui=json.load(open(base+'b-panel/panel-rows.json'))
if isinstance(ui,str): ui=json.loads(ui)
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(base+'cli-m0.csv')))
n=0; bad=[]
def chk(name, a, b):
    global n; n+=1
    if str(a)!=str(b): bad.append((name,a,b))
def cents(x): return f"{x:.2f}"
def cells(prefix,label):
    return [r for r in ui[prefix] if r['label']==label][0]['cells']
# roles
for r in cli['tokens_by_role']:
    c=cells('usage-role-','usage-role-'+r['role']); t=r['tokens']
    cb=[x for x in cli['cost_by_role'] if x['role']==r['role']][0]
    chk(r['role']+' input',t['input'],c[1]); chk(r['role']+' output',t['output'],c[2]); chk(r['role']+' cache_read',t['cache_read'],c[3])
    chk(r['role']+' cost',cents(cb['cost']['amount']),c[4]); chk(r['role']+' multiplier',f"{cb['multiplier_key']} x{cb['multiplier']:g}",c[5])
# lanes
for l in cli['tokens_by_lane']:
    c=cells('usage-lane-','usage-lane-'+l['lane']); t=l['tokens']
    chk(l['lane']+' input',t['input'],c[1]); chk(l['lane']+' output',t['output'],c[2]); chk(l['lane']+' cr',t['cache_read'],c[3]); chk(l['lane']+' cost',cents(l['cost']['amount']),c[4])
# milestones (tokens_by_milestone + csv cycle/rework)
csvm={r['id']:r for r in rows if r['scope']=='milestone'}
for m in cli['tokens_by_milestone']:
    key=m['milestone'] or '(none)'; c=cells('usage-milestone-','usage-milestone-'+key); t=m['tokens']
    chk(key+' input',t['input'],c[1]); chk(key+' output',t['output'],c[2]); chk(key+' cr',t['cache_read'],c[3]); chk(key+' cost',cents(m['cost']['amount']),c[4])
    if key in csvm:
        chk(key+' cycle_s',csvm[key]['cycle_s'],c[5]); chk(key+' rework_windows',csvm[key]['rework_windows'],c[6]); chk(key+' csv cost_usd',csvm[key]['cost_usd'][:-2] if False else f"{float(csvm[key]['cost_usd']):.2f}",c[4]); chk(key+' price_table',csvm[key]['price_table'],'2026-10-22')
nm=len(csvm)
# waste tokens
for cause,t in cli['tokens_in_waste_by_cause'].items():
    if cause=='throttled': continue
    c=cells('usage-waste-','usage-waste-'+cause)
    chk(cause+' input',t['input'],c[1]); chk(cause+' output',t['output'],c[2]); chk(cause+' cr',t['cache_read'],c[3])
th=cli['tokens_in_waste_by_cause']['throttled']
import re
txt=[r for r in ui['usage-throttled'] if r['label']=='usage-throttled-tokens'][0]['text']
chk('throttled tokens',f"{th['input']} / {th['output']} / {th['cache_read']}",txt.split(': ')[1])
# throttled intervals
for i,iv in enumerate(cli['throttled']['intervals']):
    c=cells('throttled','throttled-interval-%d'%i)
    chk('thr from',iv['from'],c[0]); chk('thr to',iv['to'],c[1]); chk('thr reason',iv['reason'],c[2]); chk('thr minutes',iv['minutes'],c[3]); chk('thr ms',iv['milestone'] or '(none)',c[4])
rt=[r for r in ui['throttled'] if r['label']=='throttled-run'][0]['text']
chk('thr run minutes',f"Run: {cli['throttled']['mission_minutes']} min",rt)
chk('thr per milestone',cli['throttled']['per_milestone'],{})
# model comparison
for m in cli['model_comparison']:
    c=cells('usage-comparison-',f"usage-comparison-{m['role']}-{m['model']}")
    chk(m['role']+m['model']+' cost',cents(m['cost']['amount']),c[2]); chk(m['role']+m['model']+' cpf',cents(m['cost_per_completed_feature']),c[3])
    chk(m['role']+m['model']+' fp',f"{m['first_pass_active_s_per_completed_feature']:.1f}",c[4]); chk(m['role']+m['model']+' n',m['completed_features'],c[5])
chk('model rows count',len(cli['model_comparison']),len([r for r in ui['usage-comparison-']]))
# budget, price table, cost so far
chk('price table',f"Price table: {cli['price_table']} ({cli['currency']})",[r for r in ui['usage-price-table']][0]['text'])
chk('budget',cli['budget']['enabled'],False)
chk('budget text','Budget: off (no budget set)',ui['usage-budget'][0]['text'])
chk('cost so far',f"Cumulative cost: {cents(cli['cost_so_far']['amount'])} USD (price table 2026-10-22)",ui['sparkline'][1]['text'])
# panel waste groups vs csv mission-level sums
w=cli['mission']['waste_s']
grp={'Waiting on human':w['waiting_human_question']+w['waiting_human_permission']+w['waiting_merge'],'Waiting on validation':w['waiting_validation'],'Rework':w['rework'],'Retry':w['retry_failure'],'Idle':w['idle_queued']+w['idle_unscheduled']}
tk=cli['tokens_in_waste_by_cause']
tg={'Waiting on human':['waiting_human_question','waiting_human_permission','waiting_merge'],'Waiting on validation':['waiting_validation'],'Rework':['rework'],'Retry':['retry_failure'],'Idle':['idle_queued','idle_unscheduled']}
for g in [r for r in ui['waste-group'] if r['tag']=='TR']:
    c=g['cells']; k=c[0]
    chk(k+' seconds',grp[k],c[1])
    for j,f in enumerate(['input','output','cache_read']): chk(k+' tok '+f,sum(tk[x][f] for x in tg[k]),c[2+j])
print('rows compared',n,'disagreeing',len(bad)); [print(b) for b in bad]
print('milestone csv rows',nm,sorted(csvm))
feat=[r for r in rows if r['scope']=='feature']
print('feature rows in CSV',len(feat),'; timeline rows in UI',len([r for r in ui['panel-timeline-row']]), 'mission.features',cli['mission']['features'])
print('timeline names match csv:',sorted(r['text'].split('active')[0].split('idle_')[0].split('retry_')[0] for r in ui['panel-timeline-row'])==sorted(r['id'] for r in feat))
print('waste_ cols',sum(1 for c in rows[0].keys() if c.startswith('waste_')),'price_table col values',sorted({r['price_table'] for r in rows}))
print('legend',[r['text'] for r in ui['waste-legend'] if r['tag']=='LI'])
print('throttled in svg waste?', any('hrottled' in r['text'] for r in ui['waste-bar']), any('hrottled' in x for x in ui['wasteRects']))
EOF
python3 $E/compare.py | tee $E/compare-output.txt
